product_one_liner.value: Curve Dental provides an AI-powered, cloud-based all-in-one practice-management platform for dental practices, connecting clinical care, scheduling, insurance, billing, payments, imaging, and patient engagement.

employee_band.notes: The cited company profile reports 215 employees.

eng_blog.notes: The company blog index is a marketing/product blog; the reviewed material does not establish two engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: Curve points users to Curve Community, described as a comprehensive knowledge base with FAQs, user guides, videos, and articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live posting is titled AI/ML Platform Software Developer.

model_provider.value: Pearl AI, Mango Voice, Bola AI, and Patient Prism
model_provider.notes: Curve publicly identifies these providers for its imaging, call-summary, voice-to-note, and patient-acquisition AI integrations; it does not name a base model.

compliance_certs.notes: The page says Curve is ISO 9001 certified and describes AWS ISO 27001 certification and HIPAA-compliant data-center security.

last_funding.notes: The round amount was not disclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified funding round is dated February 2018, outside the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The cited live listing is for a Customer Account Executive.

launched_6mo.notes: Curve announced Curve Care+ on 2026-07-14 and Curve Memberships on 2026-09-03, both within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Curve's news page dates the appointment of Rick Hansen as Chief Customer Officer to 2026-09-03.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The live Customer Account Executive posting explicitly names Salesforce and Gong.
